name: Robylon
description: Handles customer support across chat, email, WhatsApp, tickets and voice; exposes a REST API for workflow and voice triggers plus a read-only OAuth-gated MCP server over support data.

skills.name: Support Analytics
skills.description: Returns workspace support analytics through the read-only get_analytics MCP tool.

skills.name: Conversation Search
skills.description: Searches past support conversations across channels with the read-only search_conversations MCP tool.

skills.name: Conversation Retrieval
skills.description: Fetches a single support conversation and its messages with the read-only get_conversation MCP tool.

skills.name: Workspace Listing
skills.description: Lists the Robylon workspaces an authorized account can read, using the read-only list_workspaces MCP tool.

skills.name: Workflow Trigger API
skills.description: Starts a configured support workflow through the authenticated POST /triggers/v2/execute REST endpoint.

skills.name: Voice Call Triggers
skills.description: Places and tests outbound voice agent calls through the authenticated /voice/agent/trigger-call and test-call endpoints.
